description: Start a bulk AI translation of products, step 2 of 2, after estimate_catalog_translation. The CRM translates from the workspace's base language into the given languages and fills only empty fields; a model is translated once for all its colours and sizes. It runs in the background, usually for up to a few hours, spends the workspace's AI credits and stops at the limit keeping what is done. Requires the workspace owner's switch for AI bulk translation in Settings → Integrations → Connect AI, which is off by default. Starting again replaces the previous translation. Follow it with get_catalog_translation_status. The result echoes the workspace.

scope.description: WHICH products. Prefer a named container (category, brand, supplier, warehouse) when the person says 'all products of …' — it is read back by name in the preview. There is no free filter: a request like 'everything cheaper than 100' is not a scope; find the products first and send their ids.

ids.description: Explicit product ids actually fetched with search_products, at most 100.

kind.description: Specific products you fetched. Prefer a container.

id.description: The warehouse id returned by list_warehouses.
The category id returned by list_categories.

includeSubcategories.description: true to include every sub-category under it ('everything under Backpacks'); omit it for exactly that one category. Never widen it unless the person means the whole branch.

id.description: The brand id returned by list_brands.
The supplier id returned by list_suppliers.
The model id from get_product (its model block).

kind.description: Every article of one product model.

targetLocales.description: Languages to translate into, ISO 639-1. They must be languages the workspace offers (list_content_locales) other than its base language.
